needs.premise: One activation generation, two transport deliveries, one active published/scanning view; original owner, complete stable roots, native stop/layout and managed typed-allocation admission are premises; neither C weak memory nor arbitrary collector/continuation execution is simulated

18 conditional declarations: close/commit exclusion, pin release/query Step/Trace conservation, write/reclaim rejection and indistinguishable legacy debit outcomes; not all QNT actions or C source/GC simulation

Only original owner arbiter commits a return through one activation control; queue/reserve is revocable and never grants direct C jump; closing and commit are mutually exclusive; consuming a committed return leaves live activation eligible for a fresh legal Scheme return, while duplicate transport receipt/old generation cannot repeat delivery

Close admission before guard pop, revoke uncommitted reservations without waiting for requester ACK, preserve already committed target until owner matching consumption; transfer backed roots/init/physical duty before Closed publication; external close request is not permission to destroy C activation; no owner/claim/GC reverse wait

Clear marker only under valid root/heap write permit after published and claimed view obligations, object borrowers and prior writer drain, with new object-borrow admission closed at logical closing; do not hold permit while waiting for external borrower; unknown clear is replayable only as same false store with known stopped writer, valid shape and exact root-backed identity; no unknown decrement replay

Managed marker cohort uses typed allocation with raw initial still-refcount zero and canonical registered root pin before admission; root ledger owns one idempotent release receipt, never raw --; every raw refcount writer/reader and opaque access must reject or be migrated for that cohort; legacy initial-one bridge retains root/debt on unknown debit and cannot infer outcome from scalar count

Root descriptor/index and epoch view must cover pending marker and quarantine before GC setup; counter-zero managed markers enter still mark queue through explicit root trace; no marker write/root unregister during published-but-unclaimed or claimed view; physical collection follows actual root/heap reachability and completed phase, not pin receipt or C pop

Distinguish C activation right, object/root borrow, metadata reader and independent committed result custody; acquire metadata protection during registry lookup; managed discriminator/key remains lifetime-stable in captured marker after metadata removal, so managed missing identity rejects late return without stale pointer while legacy classification remains unchanged; drain all required pins before record/generation reuse, preserve captured continuation roots and already committed results; no root/credit refund from unknown legacy debit

Actual C race freedom and release/acquire/lock refinement for lookup+pin, activation reservation/return commit/closing control, backed handoff, phase-scoped marker clear, pin-ledger release and generation reuse; changing raw -- to atomic does not add per-operation identity or memory reclamation proof

Preserve current continuation destination and logical GVM frame coordinate through inner guard and CFUN bridges; never restore abandoned entry fp or invoke winding/destructor callbacks during settlement; only matched ___call consumes target frame; internal UNWIND_C_STACK_TO_TRAMPOLINE trips remain consumed by its loop and never close invocation; original activation/OS thread/processor generation and nonlocal-jump ABI remain mandatory

Root cells and error/result/destination descriptors outlive every escaped C frame; logical activation close precedes pop, actual marker clear/refcount decrement waits exclusive root/heap write permission; return handler validates authoritative activation state without changing processor-hook ordering; queued return requests cannot resurrect closed activations; nonzero RC scan/teardown closure still required

Guard closes bounded writers, publishes exact stopped initialization duty to pre-backed service escrow and preserves already committed wrapper/result right; no replay, rollback, root retirement or ticket refund from exception/unknown response; unknown managed stop/layout refuses admission or fail-stops violated admitted premise, never waits in an owner/GC cycle or fabricates ordinary return

Existing CFUN TRY, W_ALL/R_ALL, argument conversion releases and custom AT_END effects remain caller obligations; qualify every intervening native frame and cleanup origin, settle native temporaries or explicitly transfer permitted duties before propagation; foreign-library continuation escape unsupported without contract, not converted to Tcl success/error by fiat

C memory/lifetime refinement for stable pre-setjmp record handle, canonical result read, activation close/return claim, off-stack root publication, deferred physical marker write/refcount, catcher restore before propagation and generation reuse; acquire/release or locks never make raw racing SCMOBJ reads safe

retirementCosts.removedWork: Avoid wait for uncommitted external request holder before C pop
retirementCosts.bound: One owner-local commit decision per return delivery; one close-admission decision per activation exit
retirementCosts.addedCost: Registry protection, generation and delivery-receipt lookup
retirementCosts.condition: Reservation revocable; committed owner return must actually consume before close; no wall-clock wait bound proved

retirementCosts.removedWork: Preserve repeated legal return into still-live activation
retirementCosts.bound: At most 1 delivery per transport id; potentially multiple fresh ids per live activation
retirementCosts.condition: Transport id is not continuation identity; no blanket one-return lifetime restriction

retirementCosts.removedWork: Separate logical Closed from collector-writable heap mutation
retirementCosts.bound: One known successful false state; uncertain idempotent clear may repeat same assignment after qualified stop
retirementCosts.addedCost: Root/write permit, published-view drain and object-borrow gates
retirementCosts.condition: No implication of atomicity, safe signal recovery or source proof from idempotence

retirementCosts.removedWork: Retire raw still -- for qualified managed marker cohort
retirementCosts.bound: One logical root-pin release receipt per marker; 0 raw refcount decrement on new managed path
retirementCosts.addedCost: Typed marker allocation, root-domain trace and canonical ledger update
retirementCosts.condition: Initial raw count zero only with complete strong-root admission and all raw refcount/opaque access paths migrated

retirementCosts.removedWork: Keep GC safe without guessing or replaying decrement
retirementCosts.bound: 0 extra raw debit after unknown; exact strong root/duty retained
retirementCosts.addedCost: Potential indefinite marker/procedure graph retention and budget exhaustion
retirementCosts.condition: Same visible count can represent applied/not-applied histories with other writers; generic recovery remains unresolved

retirementCosts.removedWork: Exclude both unclaimed and active scanners from mutation
retirementCosts.bound: Published view blocks permit before worker claim; permit blocks new view until bounded update ends
retirementCosts.addedCost: Epoch/view state, scan/root leases and stopped-writer receipts
retirementCosts.condition: A zero active-scanner count alone is insufficient; unknown in-flight managed writer still blocks this permission

retirementCosts.removedWork: Allow closed marker collection while metadata observer remains
retirementCosts.bound: Metadata readers keep control record only; object borrowers retain root and block physical clear
retirementCosts.addedCost: Two distinct lease classes and root/record retirement policies
retirementCosts.condition: Existing raw marker readers must be audited; missing identity/generation maps closed, not freed-pointer access

retirementCosts.removedWork: Reuse still-object marking for counter-zero explicit roots
retirementCosts.bound: Existing mark_array still CAS path can enqueue rooted marker; no new object collector needed for this fact
retirementCosts.addedCost: New root enumeration/phase integration and late-return validation
retirementCosts.condition: Captured continuation is an independent heap root; pin receipt never proves object dead

retirementCosts.removedWork: Count one physical backing through activation/service/quarantine ownership
retirementCosts.bound: Peak=max_t(H+P+N+Q); no refund at close, receipt ACK or ledger release
retirementCosts.addedCost: Deferred marker/procedure retention, delivery records and quarantine may increase peak
retirementCosts.condition: Bounded slot count alone does not bound retained procedure graph; require heap/native budgets; no peak reduction proved

retirementCosts.removedWork: Share control/root/permit/receipt support and remove implicit ownership coupling
retirementCosts.bound: 0 production paths retired today; conditional retirement of raw marker kill/debit plus ungated return check for managed cohort
retirementCosts.addedCost: Scheme generator, kernel, allocator, GC root adapter and C memory refinement all required
retirementCosts.condition: Positive latency gain only if avoided waits/replay/retention outweigh new arbitration/trace/lease costs; no incremental Zig benefit or measured speedup

nodes.labelText: Typed marker + stable root admission\nactivation generation / transport identity
Queue / reserve return intent\nmetadata protection; revocable
Original-owner activation arbiter\ncommit return OR close admission
ReturnCommitted -> matching consume\nfresh legal return may use same marker
Close reservations + accept backed duty\npublish Closed before C pop
Published / scanning root view\nphysical permit mutually exclusive
Root + stopped writer + heap permit\nclear marker; reconcile only idempotent store
Managed root-pin release receipt\nnew cohort has no raw --
Legacy raw decrement unknown\nretain exact root and duty; never replay
Root-domain tracing + actual heap reachability\ncaptured continuation may retain closed marker
Object borrow / metadata readers separate\nrecord reuse after exact pin drain
SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean\nsource / C-memory refinements open

callers.actualChain: make_sfun_stack_marker creates 1/2 element still vector with refcount one; alloc_scmobj links before caller fills body
callers.hazard: Managed ledger cannot simply be bolted on and then decrement old pin twice
callers.replacement: Typed marker allocator/root admission replaces initial legacy pin for new cohort; old allocation remains legacy-only

callers.hazard: Logical C activation invalidity, heap write and native pin drop are currently coupled
callers.replacement: Close native activation first; accepted cleanup duty owns later permitted physical clear and profile-specific pin release

callers.actualChain: Still refcount inc/dec/read are plain field accesses; release_scmobj invokes decrement for still objects
callers.hazard: Void decrement has no operation receipt; scalar count cannot identify which owner released
callers.replacement: Gate raw exports for managed cohort; canonical root-pin ledger; legacy uncertain debit quarantines exact root/duty

callers.actualChain: Return handler routes wrong processor, tests marker false, writes all GVM state and throws to ___call
callers.hazard: Check-then-jump can race a future independent close; changing routing order alters Scheme hooks/errors
callers.replacement: Preserve route order, then original-owner claim commit against authoritative activation state and exact rooted destination

callers.actualChain: ___call rethrows nonmatching destination and consumes matching fp/R0 only on its own marker
callers.hazard: Closing a committed target early or consuming stale packet can destroy live C stack semantics
callers.replacement: ReturnCommitted pins real activation until original owner consumes; close request deferred, not blocked remote holder

callers.actualChain: SFUN error loops call ___call again with same marker before END invalidation
callers.hazard: One return ever per activation would break existing reentrant conversion handling
callers.replacement: Deduplicate delivery instance only; fresh legal Scheme invocation while activation Open is preserved

callers.actualChain: Hook migrates Scheme thread to marker processor; logical C activation still belongs to original native owner
callers.hazard: A queued request/processor id is not an OS-thread longjmp capability
callers.replacement: Stable activation generation, owner/lineage dispatch and tombstone rejection; arbitrary native-stack migration not admitted

callers.actualChain: GC setup seeds still queue when refcount nonzero, otherwise mark=-1; scan list follows mark links
callers.hazard: Managed raw count zero needs independent registered root enumeration before weak/finish closure
callers.replacement: Typed root-domain scan adapter; publication/claim/trace/drain receipts protect descriptor and object storage

callers.actualChain: mark_array can enqueue unmarked still objects with CAS in SMP; RC data roots scanned only in P0 branch; FOREIGN payload opaque
callers.hazard: Existing mark mechanism helps but root-domain completeness/nonzero RC ownership are not supplied
callers.replacement: Reuse still mark primitive with full processor/root coverage; independent root writer authority and typed marker layout proof

callers.actualChain: Sweep frees objects whose mark remains -1 and recomputes still accounting
callers.hazard: Pin release or lost receipt cannot authorize eager object free before real heap/continuation reachability
callers.replacement: Keep service/quarantine strong root through safe known cleanup; captured closed marker may remain heap-reachable

callers.actualChain: Teardown frees still objects and RC chain unconditionally
callers.hazard: Refcount/pin alone does not survive VM teardown; readers can retain control and distinct results
callers.replacement: Drain or physical domain transfer before teardown; metadata-only readers separate from marker/code/native borrowers

callers.actualChain: Generator creates static/dynamic SFUN entries; actual host/Tcl/function callbacks consume results and retain external resources
callers.hazard: Raw ABI/private marker exposure and native-library continuation legality remain real admission limits
callers.replacement: Scheme emits activation/transport identities and root/borrow descriptors; modern C service shared, qualified legacy bridge retained
